Avoid unnecessary movement of an injured person, since unskilled handling may worsen an injury. After a crash on a multilane highway or expressway with no apparent serious injury or death, drivers must move the involved vehicles to a safe refuge when the vehicles can be driven normally and safely. Move a crash vehicle only if doing so will not create further danger or harm to people, the vehicles or the roadway. If a crash participant cannot move the vehicle, that person may ask a nearby driver with a valid license of the appropriate class to move it. Moving a vehicle to safety under the described crash rule does not by itself establish fault or eliminate the driver's duties to stop and provide information.
